description.content: Get list of audiences for the ad account.

query.description: Cursor used to fetch the next page of items

The order in which to sort the items returned: ASCENDING or DESCENDING by ID.
For received audiences, it is sorted by sharing event time.
Note that higher-value IDs are associated with more-recently added items.
Maximum number of items to include in a single page of the response. See documentation on Pagination for more information.
This feature is currently in beta and not available to all apps. Filter audiences by ownership type.
